The *Revatabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 7), translated as *The History of the Buddha Revata*, is the seventh chapter of the *Buddhavaṁsa* in the Pali Canon. It presents the traditional verse biography and legendary account of Revata, one of the past Buddhas venerated in the Theravāda lineage tradition.
